data.long_meaning: Janek is a Slavic name derived from the Old Slavic word Jan, meaning 'God is gracious'. This name was popular among Eastern European Christians, and is still used today as a strong and meaningful Christian boy name. The name Janek carries the meaning “God is gracious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
